We appreciate your feedback and are committed to providing a seamless gaming experience.

notes.title: Announcing the Release of Sliming Game Demo!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of the demo version of our highly anticipated indie game, 

"Sliming"! Embark on a thrilling adventure as you guide the adorable slime towards its destination. 

The gameplay is anything but cute, igniting your spirit of challenge. Navigate through intricately designed levels, overcome challenging obstacles, and strive to reach the ultimate goal. Experience the joy of getting one step closer to your destination. 

Become a part of the "Sliming" adventure by trying out the demo!

Please note that the demo version is for playtesting purposes and may include some mechanics and areas that are not fully polished.
